title.narrative: National STD/AIDS Control Program - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, HIV, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Ensure high quality provision of Continuum of Prevention to Treatment and Care services to all populations in need. Prevent new HIV infections in key population and vulnerable groups. The objectives of this program are: Achieve 80% of geographically covered key populations and other vulnerable groups with targeted prevention programs and outreach. Ensure the availability, analysis, and use of HIV/STI strategic information, for all priority areas of the NSP. Improve current detection of estimated PLHIV by 20% through targeted HIV testing strategies. Provide high quality HIV diagnostic, treatment, and care services to 100% of PLHIV registered into HIV care. Reduce to less than 15%, the loss to follow-up of identified PLHIV entry into pre-ART care
